versions.subject: rule: suspicious camera and mic access
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    EventId: 13
    TargetObject|contains:
        - \Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\CapabilityAccessManager\ConsentStore\\*\NonPackaged
selection_2:
    TargetObject|contains:
        - microphone
        - webcam
selection_3:
    TargetObject|contains:
        - '#C:#Windows#Temp#'
        - '#C:#$Recycle.bin#'
        - '#C:#Temp#'
        - '#C:#Users#Public#'
        - '#C:#Users#Default#'
        - '#C:#Users#Desktop#'
condition: all of selection_*
